name: Keeper Nuala

intro.text: The tide's turning. It always is, in Galway. I've rowed a currach out past the Aran Islands in worse than you.
Tide creatures are patient and then they're not. Ready?

win: You held your course. That's all the sea ever asks. The Tide Stone's yours.
after: Come back on a calm day and I'll take you out to see the gannets dive.
